visitors.parse.title: Parse RB2B Visitor Webhook Payload
visitors.parse.description: Parse and normalize a raw RB2B visitor-identified webhook payload into a structured NormalizedVisitor object. No network call is made — this is a pure normalization action useful for agents that receive the raw payload from an RB2B webhook and need to extract person-level identity fields (name, LinkedIn URL, emails, company, title, location, pages visited).

payload.description: The raw RB2B webhook payload object exactly as delivered by the webhook endpoint. Expected fields (all optional, connector tolerates missing values): first_name, last_name, linkedin_url, business_email, personal_emails (array of strings), company_name, job_title, city, region, all_time_page_views or pages (array of {url, timestamp}), timestamp.

visitor.description: The normalized visitor object with camelCase fields.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the RB2B connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
